dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Mum is beside him.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: The room is quiet and comfortable.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Good. We're all together.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Dad isn't sad now.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Right. He's happy with us at the park.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: He's beside us near the bench.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Our dog is near the bench too.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Our bags are on the seat.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: The park is quiet, and everyone is happy.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mum
dialogue_turns.text: You two are very quiet this morning.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: We're tired and not very happy.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mum
dialogue_turns.text: Your school bags are by the door.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Ben's coat is on the chair, and my shoes are under the bench.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mum
dialogue_turns.text: I'm in the kitchen if you need me.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Thanks. We're ready, even if we're tired.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Anna isn't a child in this picture.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Right. She's our mother.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: She's near the kitchen table with a cup.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: I'm on the chair, and you're near the door.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Dad is by the window.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Good. The family is ready for breakfast.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: The two round things under the chair aren't balls.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Right. They're apples for lunch.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: The ball is near the door beside you.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Your bag is under the table.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Mum is here at the table with me.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Good. We know what's for lunch and what's for play.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Your mother and teacher are near the gate.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Right. One is my mother.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: The other is your teacher.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: I'm between them with my bag.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: I'm near the classroom door.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Good. Everyone is ready to go home.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Tom, you look tired after school.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Tom
dialogue_turns.text: I am. My bag is beside the sofa.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Your coat is on the chair.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Tom
dialogue_turns.text: You're near me with a book.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Mia is in the kitchen.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Tom
dialogue_turns.text: Good. The living room is warm and quiet.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: We're very hot after the sunny afternoon.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Yes, our faces are red.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Our water bottles are on the bench.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Our bags are under the bench.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: The park is still bright and warm.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Let's stay calm. We're ready to go home.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: The person beside you is a woman.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Yes, she's my aunt.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Her blue coat is easy to see.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: My red bag is beside me.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Your shoes are under the bench.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Good. The hall is tidy and bright.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Dad and Joe are both at the school gate.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Tom
dialogue_turns.text: Yes, they're fathers from our two families.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: I'm beside Dad.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Tom
dialogue_turns.text: And I'm beside Joe.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Our school bags are with us.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Tom
dialogue_turns.text: Good. Everyone is ready to go home.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Mum and Aunt May are near the market entrance.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Yes, they're both from your family.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Their bags are beside them.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: You're between them near the door.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: The market is bright and busy.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Good. Everyone is together.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: You don't look tired now.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: I'm not tired. I'm rested and cheerful.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Your school bag is under the chair.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: My book is on the table.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: I'm beside you near the window.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Great. We're ready to go outside.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: We're not hot anymore.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Right. We're cool inside the house.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Our coats are on the chair.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Our bags are near the door.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: You're on the sofa, and I'm by the window.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Good. We're happy to be home.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Anna isn't your friend in this picture.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Right. She's my mother.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: She's near the kitchen table.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: I'm beside her with my school bag.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: The cup and plate are on the table.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Good. The family is ready for breakfast.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: The yellow things on the table aren't bananas.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Right. They're pencils for school.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: The bananas are in the bowl near the window.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Our school bags are under the chairs.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Mum is here at the table with us.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Good. Breakfast things and school things are easy to tell apart.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: Ben's father and Tom's father are near Ben.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Tom
dialogue_turns.text: Right. They're our fathers.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: My dad is on one side, and Tom's dad is on the other.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Mia
dialogue_turns.text: You two are between them at the school gate.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Tom
dialogue_turns.text: Our bags are on the ground.

dialogue_turns.speaker: Ben
dialogue_turns.text: Good. Everyone is ready to go home.
